scope: Independent read-only source/interpretation and receipt-arithmetic review; no new costly simulation.

checks.five_level_scope: PASS: only n=2/3 are solved; density scales electrons, protons and imposed ground/higher-level populations while radiation/escape/temperature remain fixed. Findings explicitly exclude full SE, charge, thermal and wind closure.
checks.density_inference: PASS: D~20.19 is a conditional rate response, not the required gas-density inference; higher-level populations are scaled linearly despite possible D^2/D^3 source responses.
checks.trapped_photons: PASS: local resonant recycling has already been eliminated in the effective SE operator. Removing A*escape differs from adding an independently supplied external pump; Fe/destruction/electron escape remain distinct.
checks.halpha_feedback: PASS: scaling both effective upward/downward branches is labeled sensitivity, not recomputed escape or transfer. New thick opacity does not guarantee a darker unresolved spectrum.
checks.shielding: PASS: partial-cell outward columns, gross positive absorption, signed H extinction and retained opacity are distinct. Screen columns solve tau=ln(141.58) at a stated monochromatic cross section; they are not a population prediction or a complete loss-rate attenuation solution.
checks.rate_scope: PASS: radiation receipt explicitly uses stored base rates; atomic receipt restores n2/n3 receiving terms and limits complete ionization-budget claims outside those levels.
checks.lifetime: PASS: excited-level turnover is not identified with bulk neutral survival, ionization history or long-term material confinement.
checks.boundary_pump: PASS: boundary photoionization omits atmospheric transfer/receiving terms; uniform-disk velocity averaging is an illustrative pump-direction control, not a measured planet-view stellar correction.

limitations: No new full atomic or radiative transfer solution was run.
Line/continuum shielding, photon supply, force/thermal balance and native observer improvement remain coupled untested requirements.
This review did not independently re-read every paper cited in the atomic findings.
